newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: G&W MAKES PUBLIC AND PLACEMENT SHARES IN IPO.
newsitem.headline: G&W MAKES PUBLIC AND PLACEMENT SHARES IN IPO.

text.p: G&W Group Holdings Ltd, a unit of Koh Brothers Ltd, said on Thursday it was offering a total of 27 million new shares in its initial public offer (IPO).
The IPO comprises 10.76 million shares offered to the public at Singapore $0.50 each and 8.13 million preference shares offered to eligible shareholders of Koh Brothers at the same price.
There will also be a placement tranche of 8.1 million shares at S$0.55 each, the company said in a statement.
The shares are priced at a forecast price earnings ratio of 10.6 times for the offer tranche and 11.7 times for the placement tranche, it said.
G&W has forecast a 34 percent rise in its turnover to S$130.1 million and a 23 rise in net profit to S$4.3 million for the year ending December 31, 1997.
The company, which makes construction materials and equipment, is applying for a listing on the main board of the Stock Exchange of Singapore.
It said the net proceeds of S$12.7 million from the IPO would be used to expand operations in Singapore and Malaysia.
The public offer closes August 21 and trading will start on August 25.
